n: Moroni addresses the future translator — whom Latter-day Saints know to be Joseph Smith — telling him not to try to translate the sealed portion until God allows it.
The translator may be allowed to show the plates to those who help bring forth the work.

f.g: Later fulfilled with the Eight Witnesses, among others.

n: Three people will be shown the plates by God’s power, so they will know with certainty that the record is true. This was fulfilled in the Three Witnesses — Oliver Cowdery, David Whitmer, and Martin Harris — in 1829.

f.w: unto three shall they be shown

n: By the mouth of three witnesses these things will be established. Their testimony, the record itself, and the witness of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost will stand against the world at the last day.

f.w: in the mouth of three witnesses

n: Those who repent and come to the Father in Jesus’ name will be received into God’s kingdom. The goal of the witnesses is salvation, not just proof.
If Moroni lacks authority, judge for yourself — but you will know he had it when you see him at the last day before God.

f.w: ye shall know that I have authority
